behavior: Given real indexed records inside one time window where exactly one record has the requested test.run_id and distractors share its namespace, workload, and message but have different or absent run identifiers, a run-id query returns only the exactly matching record and never falls back to a distractor.
rationale: Exact correlation depends on the query plan surviving translation into real OpenSearch semantics; a contract test with near-identical distractors catches ignored run-id filters and accidental fallback.
